creation.prompt: Create exactly one reusable Milo performance candidate as a transparent full-body PNG. Use reference 1 for canonical identity and reference 2 for the owner-approved r003 lean body proportions, waist contour, torso-to-leg balance and head/body design. Preserve rounded ears, head size, green eyes, muzzle, cream inset, grey matted wool, orange tail and short sturdy limb anatomy. Do not thicken the belly, shorten the torso, enlarge the head or stretch the anatomy. Keep a compatible three-quarter screen-right view, closed mouth without teeth, complete ears/feet/tail and comfortable margins. Neutral studio light, no background, scenery, props, labels, text or watermark. Change only the pose/contact described below; do not substitute a different animal. Passing/lift gait key: near supporting foot stays planted, far foot passes underneath the hips with a modest lift, arms swing coherently. Keep root/head/body anatomical dimensions compatible with approved contact key. This is one gait key, not a full animated cycle.
